桶数 × 桶价 ÷ 面积

howTitle.zh: 漆是按桶买的，不是按升

howP.en: The bucket says 12–14 m²/L per coat, and every quote in the trade assumes exactly that. Reality is rougher: thinned first coats sink into bare plaster, roller texture eats coverage, and corners painted by brush burn through faster. That is what the 10% waste covers. The other number people get wrong is bucket count — an 18 L bucket that covers 90% of the room still costs a whole bucket, which is why the leftover line matters when comparing quotes.
howP.zh: 桶身上写着每升涂 12–14 平米一遍，报价单全都按这个算。实际更糙：第一遍兑水后腻子基底直接吃漆，辊筒纹理吃涂布率，阴阳角用刷子走的地方掉得更快——这就是 10% 损耗的去向。另一个容易算错的数是桶数：18L 的大桶哪怕只用了 90% 也得买一整桶，所以对比报价时，「剩漆」那一行最见真章。

q.en: Primer and topcoat have different coverage. How do I handle that?
q.zh: 底漆和面漆涂布率不一样，怎么算？

a.en: Run this page twice: once for the topcoat (coats = 2), once for the primer (coats = 1, use the primer's coverage figure, usually 10–12 m²/L). Primer is cheaper per litre, so don't let a quote lump them into one bucket price.
a.zh: 这页跑两遍：面漆一遍（遍数填 2），底漆一遍（遍数填 1、涂布率按底漆标的 10–12）。底漆每升便宜得多，报价单把两者混成一桶价的都是糊弄。

q.en: Should I round up to the next bucket?
q.zh: 差一点也要多买一整桶吗？

a.en: Yes — paint is sold in sealed buckets, and a half-bucket shortfall cannot be bought. Keep the sealed one: unopened buckets usually return, opened ones are your future touch-up colour batch. Never tint-match touch-up paint from a different batch.
a.zh: 要——漆按密封桶卖，差半升也得买一整桶。多出来的那桶别拆封：没开封的一般能退，开了封的就是你将来补漆的同批次色浆，补漆千万别用别的批次调色。

q.en: Why is my wall area different from the floor area times 3?
q.zh: 为什么墙面面积不等于地面面积 × 3？

a.en: The ×3 rule of thumb assumes 2.6–2.8 m ceilings and ignores openings. It is fine for a budget in your head, but at ¥8–15/m² of paint, a 10% error on a 200 m² villa is a bucket and a half. Measure once.
a.zh: 「地面积 ×3」是按 2.6–2.8 米层高、不算洞口的口算，预算够用。但漆每平米 8–15 元，200 平的大平层差 10% 就差出一桶半漆，值得拿卷尺量一次。

q.en: Does colour depth change how much I need?

a.en: Yes. Deep reds, blues and blacks are tinted on a transparent base and rarely cover in two coats — plan three, or use the matching grey primer the brand sells for that colour. The calculator stays the same; just set coats = 3.
a.zh: 是。大红、深蓝、黑色用的是透明基料调色，两遍基本盖不住——按三遍算，或者用品牌配套的灰色底漆。计算器不用改，遍数填 3 就行。

note.en: One-time. Unlocks ceilings, multi-room totals and primer plans.
note.zh: 一次性买断。解锁天花、多房间汇总和底漆方案。
